_notes: Authored here, unlike contracts/ which are generated from Stromy. Join table: workflow -> entitled client slugs -> the client-facing wf-* skill. Default-deny: a workflow absent from this file, or present with an empty clients list, is operator-only. Every slug must match an Entra app role in terraform/entra.tf (local.workflow_app_roles) -- adding a slug here does not grant the role. scripts/check_entitlements.py fails CI when a contract has no entry here.
